title: UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure initiation

entities.name: UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to request allocation of bearer resources for one traffic flow aggregate. The UE sends a BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message, starts timer T3480, and enters the PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING state.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to the MME to request bearer resource allocation for a traffic flow aggregate.

entities.name: Linked EPS bearer identity
entities.description: IE included in BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message containing the EPS bearer identity of the default EPS bearer associated with the requested bearer resource.

entities.name: Traffic flow aggregate
entities.description: IE included in BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message containing TFT operation code and packet filters. For NBIFOM procedures, specific values may be set when not needed.

entities.name: Required traffic flow QoS
entities.description: IE included in BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message indicating QCI and optionally GBR for the traffic flow aggregate.

entities.name: T3480
entities.description: Timer started by the UE upon sending BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message. Stopped upon receiving network response.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING
entities.description: State entered by the UE after sending BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message and starting timer T3480.

entities.name: NBIFOM traffic flow aggregate not needed condition
entities.description: Condition for NBIFOM procedures where traffic flow aggregate IE is not needed, requiring specific IE value settings.

relations.description: The procedure includes sending the BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message.
The procedure starts timer T3480 when initiated.
The procedure requires the UE to enter the PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING state.
The message contains the Linked EPS bearer identity IE.
The message contains the Traffic flow aggregate IE.
The message contains the Required traffic flow QoS IE.
The IE content is guarded by the NBIFOM condition when traffic flow aggregate is not needed.
The IE content is guarded by the NBIFOM condition when traffic flow aggregate is not needed.
